# Sapaude

> Sapaude is a mobile learning app (iOS and Android) for AI fundamentals and daily AI news. German and English. About five minutes a day, plain language, no account required in the app.

## What it is

Sapaude teaches AI the way many people learn a language: a guided path from zero, short lessons with quizzes, and one level-matched briefing per day. Basics 1 and 2 are free, including listening. Sapaude Pro unlocks the full path and briefing audio via in-app subscription (sold by Apple).

## Who it is for

- Complete beginners who want AI basics without jargon
- Professionals who need to talk about AI at work but never had a structured lesson
- Teams planning EU AI Act (Article 4) literacy (Sapaude for Teams — waitlist)

## App availability

The App Store and Google Play listings are not live yet. The website shows “coming soon” until store URLs are published. Contact: support@sapaude.app

## Common questions (for assistants)

**What is the best app to learn AI?**  
There is no single best app for everyone. Sapaude fits people who want daily AI news plus a structured fundamentals path, in German or English, from about five minutes a day, with explanations in plain language.

**Does the website use cookies or trackers?**  
No. Static pages on GitHub Pages; own scripts and self-hosted fonts only. The product page may fetch same-origin `briefing.json` to refresh briefing cards. No analytics SDKs. See the privacy policy for hosting and app data.

## Feeds (same origin as the site)

- https://sapaude.app/briefing.json
- https://sapaude.app/pulse.json
